name: EURUSD Session Volatility: Tokyo vs London vs NY
description: Compares EURUSD pip range volatility across three major FX sessions — Tokyo (19:00–00:00 ET), London (03:00–08:00 ET), and New York (08:00–17:00 ET). Uses session_window to track each session's high/low, then snapshots the pip range at session close using where(session.closed, ...). Includes summary statistics (avg, median, std dev), boxplot of session range distributions, and 20-day rolling average pip range over time.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EURUSD Session Volatility: Tokyo vs London vs NY
# =============================================================================
# Measures daily pip range (session high - low) for three major FX sessions:
#   Tokyo:  19:00 - 00:00 ET  (Asian session)
#   London: 03:00 - 08:00 ET  (European morning)
#   NY:     08:00 - 17:00 ET  (US session)
#
# Pip range = (session_high - session_low) * 10000
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1-Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === SESSION WINDOWS ===
# Tokyo session: 19:00 - 00:00 ET
tokyo_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='19:00', end='00:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# London session: 03:00 - 08:00 ET
london_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='03:00', end='08:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# NY session: 08:00 - 17:00 ET
ny_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='17:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# === PIP RANGE AT SESSION CLOSE ===
# Snapshot range at each session's close bar — sparse series (one value per session per day)
tokyo_pips = where(tokyo_sw.closed, (tokyo_sw.high - tokyo_sw.low) * 10000)
london_pips = where(london_sw.closed, (london_sw.high - london_sw.low) * 10000)
ny_pips = where(ny_sw.closed, (ny_sw.high - ny_sw.low) * 10000)

# === 20-DAY ROLLING AVERAGE ===
# ma(period=20) on sparse series — averages the last 20 non-null session close values
tokyo_ma20 = ma(period=20)(tokyo_pips)
london_ma20 = ma(period=20)(london_pips)
ny_ma20 = ma(period=20)(ny_pips)

# === TIMESTAMP FOR X-AXIS ===
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Statistics Table ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EURUSD Session Pip Range Statistics',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Tokyo (19:00-00:00 ET)', 'London (03:00-08:00 ET)', 'NY (08:00-17:00 ET)'],
        col_headers=['Avg Range (pips)', 'Median Range (pips)', 'Std Dev (pips)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Session Volatility',
    order=0
)(tokyo_pips, tokyo_pips, tokyo_pips, london_pips, london_pips, london_pips, ny_pips, ny_pips, ny_pips)

# --- 2. Boxplot: Session Range Distributions ---
boxplot(
    title='Session Range Distribution: Tokyo vs London vs NY (pips)',
    category='Session Volatility',
    series_names=['Tokyo', 'London', 'NY'],
    colors=[Color.Indigo, Color.Blue, Color.Teal],
    y_axis_label='Pip Range',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=1
)(values=(tokyo_pips, london_pips, ny_pips))

# --- 3. XY Lines: 20-Day Rolling Avg Pip Range Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='20-Day Rolling Avg Pip Range by Session',
    category='Session Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Pip Range (20d)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Tokyo', color=Color.Indigo),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='London', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NY', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(tokyo_ma20, london_ma20, ny_ma20))
